voltage_line_to_line.description: Line-to-line (phase-to-phase) RMS voltage of the balanced three-phase system

current_line.description: Line RMS current of the balanced three-phase system

power_factor.description: cos(phi), magnitude only -- direction given separately by power_factor_type

power_factor_type.description: lagging (inductive load, Q > 0) or leading (capacitive load, Q < 0); defaults to lagging
